_comment: Illustrative schema for the HRKB JSON produced by code/build_kb.py. Prototype texts are MLLM-generated abstractions; centroids are truncated here for readability (the real index stores full 512-d CLIP vectors).

prototypes.prototype_text: Uses mockery of a public figure's cognitive or physical decline to imply systemic incompetence, delegitimizing their authority through personal ridicule.
Invokes false historical equivalence between minority groups and criminal behavior to implicitly legitimize discrimination.
Employs relatable everyday frustration humor through exaggerated self-deprecation, inviting shared identification rather than hostility.
